messages:
alex-eng: heads up, i landed a small import flow in sandbox to bulk update route weights + quota caps via a CSV. want a quick safety/telemetry check before we enable for product teams

maria: can you share the import behavior? merge vs replace semantics are critical for routing rules

alex-eng: import supports 3 modes: preview (no change), merge (only specified fields updated), replace (entire route config replaced). preview is default. we also add a dry-run flag `apply=false` for API imports

lee: telemetry: emit event `config.import.run` with mode, actor, preview=true/false, file_sha. include counts: rows_processed, rows_applied. for non-preview runs emit `config.change` events per-route (batched) so we can correlate with quota/latency spikes

ops-oncall: runbook: if after apply we see route error rate up >1% absolute or latency p50 jump >50ms in 10m, auto-open a revert task and set routes back from a pre-import snapshot. can we snapshot before apply?

alex-eng: yes, we create a pre-import snapshot and store the snapshot_id in the import metadata. revert API is simply POST /api/imports/:id/revert which uses the snapshot.

maria: api contract question  what does import return? need idempotency and conflict semantics for concurrent imports

alex-eng: import returns an import_id and uses optimistic locking on the target config version. for apply=true we require header If-Match: "<config-etag>" and will 409 if base changed since preview. preview runs don't require etag. snippet:
```
POST /api/v1/config/imports
Headers: If-Match: "<etag>"  # required only for apply=true
Body: { "mode": "merge", "apply": true, "file_sha": "abcd1234" }
```

lee: add small-sample request tagging: sample 1/500 requests with header `x-config-import-id` for 30m after apply so traces include the import context. and derive metric `route.error_rate_by_import` to backfill if needed

ux-sim: UX: in console preview show a per-route diff with before/after weight + quota and a heatmap for traffic volume. highlight routes where weight change >10% of total route weight in a single import and require an explicit high-risk confirmation checkbox

maria: also require that replace mode cannot be run from console without a two-step confirmation and owner approval; dangerous to accidentally wipe fields

alex-eng: agreed. console will block replace-mode applies and route them to a small approval queue. CLI/API can still do replace with appropriate RBAC and If-Match.

ops-oncall: include automatic observability rules: create a transient alert window for 30m post-apply that suppresses noisy alerts but creates a summary ticket with deltas (error rate, p50, cost estimate). if deltas exceed thresholds then trigger full pager and revert suggestion

lee: minor: persist file_sha and actor in change events so we can trace to the uploaded artifact. and attach recent_deploy_id if deploy within last 15m

alex-eng: plan: 1) keep preview default; 2) snapshot before apply; 3) add events and counters; 4) sample traces with x-config-import-id; 5) console diff + high-risk gating; 6) approval flow for replace; 7) transient alert window + revert task. i'll push a staging build tomorrow and post the import_id for a manual test

umm: ingest-bot: created import task #8452 (preview) for file abcd1234. (automated) :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: i'll prepare the revert playbook and the alert thresholds. please ping when staging import_id is ready for the 15m smoke check

alex-eng: thanks all, will post staging link and import_id here.
